criteria.description:

The ResourcePlan fully satisfies all DA013 criteria:

1. **Monthly budget compliance**: All 12 months stay within the $900 cap (verified: Jan=$80, Apr=$280, May=$840, Jun=$840, Jul=$880, Aug=$800, Sep=$880, Oct=$680, Nov=$0, Dec=$840).

5. **Achieves maximum service priority score**: All months achieve optimal points on the complete Pareto frontier (ResourceFrontier sheet with 153 reachable states). Total: 2488 points across 47 sessions, $6120 total spend.

7. **Rejection of unproven greedy optimality**: DecisionAudit properly rejects DA-D1 with concrete evidence, and the solution uses dynamic programming / complete enumeration rather than greedy selection.

All three deliverables (outdoor_activity_model.xlsx, activity_policy_brief.docx, review_calendar.csv) are consistent and provide verifiable proof of optimality.
